title: Antwerp Edge Oostende in Overtime to Seal a Historic Treble
description: Windrose Giants Antwerp are champions of Belgium for the first time, surviving a dramatic overtime in Game 5 against Filou Oostende to win the deciding game of the finals and complete a historic treble. For the first time since 2011, Belgian basketball has a new national champion. The decider lived up to its billing the first Game 5 in the Belgian finals since 2014. Threes flew at both ends early, and Antwerp were first to create separation, leading 22-28 after the opening quarter and 45-41 at the break as Oostende answered every blow. Antwerp looked to be taking control in the third, pushing the lead to ten (65-55) behind Niels De Ridder (197-F-2001), Yoeri Schoepen (200-PF-1994) and Joel Murray (183-PG-1999, college: LBSU, agency: Slash Sports), but the wildest stretch was still to come.

description: Antwerp - Oostende 71-74 Oostende celebrated Pro Basketball League title. They defeated Antwerp Giants on the road in Game 4 to clinch the trophy. Antwerp Giants trailed by 12 points after 3 quarters before a 24-15 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 71-74 at the end of the game. title: ZZ Leiden conquer 22/23 BNXT title
description: Oostende - ZZ Leiden 80-91 ZZ Leiden clinched the 22/23 BNXT League title. They overcame Oostende in the decisive third game of the championship series to lift the trophy. Deion Hammond (193-G-1999, college: Monmouth, agency: One Motive Sports) scored 22 points to lead the effort. ZZ Leiden recorded a 22-19 lead after ten minutes. They unloaded 30 points in the second stanza to take a 9-point lead at the interval. Oostende narrowed the deficit and eventually eked out a one-point lead at the final break. But ZZ Leiden responded with a massive 26-14 run in the fourth frame to secure the winning outcome. Marijn Ververs (194-G-1998) nailed 19 points in the win. Nikola Jovanovic (211-C/F-1994, college: USC) answered with 15 points, while Pierre-Antoine Gillet (201-PF-1991) had 13 points in the loss.

title: Filou Oostende claim Euromillions League title
description: Belfius Mons - Oostende 62-69 Oostende are Euromillions League 20/21 champions. They beat Belfius Mons on the road in Game 4 to capture the trophy. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 18-14. But Belfius Mons-Hainaut won second period 19-16.
